concludingFormula.latin: Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus, per omnia sæcula sæculorum. ℟. Amen.
concludingFormula.english: Through Our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who livest and reignest with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. ℟. Amen.

mary.intercessionLatin: Deus, qui de beatæ Mariæ Virginis utero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiante, carnem suscipere voluisti: præsta supplicibus tuis; ut, qui vere eam Genetricem Dei credimus, eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
mary.intercessionEnglish: O God, who didst will that Thy Word should take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary at the message of an Angel: grant unto us Thy suppliants, that we who believe her to be truly the Mother of God, may be assisted by her intercession with Thee.
mary.collectLatin: Deus, qui de beatæ Mariæ Virginis utero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiante, carnem suscipere voluisti: præsta supplicibus tuis; ut, qui vere eam Genetricem Dei credimus, eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
mary.collectEnglish: O God, who didst will that Thy Word should take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary at the message of an Angel: grant unto us Thy suppliants, that we who believe her to be truly the Mother of God, may be assisted by her intercession with Thee.
mary.versicleLatin: ℣. Ora pro nobis, Sancta Dei Genetrix.
mary.versicleEnglish: ℣. Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God.
mary.responseEnglish: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

joseph.intercessionLatin: Sanctissimæ Genetricis tuæ Sponsi, quæsumus, Domine, meritis adiuvemur: ut, quod possibilitas nostra non obtinet, eius nobis intercessione donetur.
joseph.intercessionEnglish: We beseech Thee, O Lord, that we may be assisted by the merits of the Spouse of Thy most holy Mother: that what we cannot obtain of ourselves may be granted unto us by his intercession.
joseph.collectLatin: Sanctissimæ Genetricis tuæ Sponsi, quæsumus, Domine, meritis adiuvemur: ut, quod possibilitas nostra non obtinet, eius nobis intercessione donetur.
joseph.collectEnglish: We beseech Thee, O Lord, that we may be assisted by the merits of the Spouse of Thy most holy Mother: that what we cannot obtain of ourselves may be granted unto us by his intercession.
joseph.versicleEnglish: ℣. He made him lord of his house.
joseph.responseEnglish: ℟. And ruler of all his substance.

apostle.intercessionLatin: Deus, qui nos beati Apostoli tui {saintName} annua solemnitate lætificas: præsta, quæsumus; ut, cuius natalitia colimus, eius protegimur et orationibus.
apostle.intercessionEnglish: O God, who dost gladden us by the yearly festival of Thy blessed Apostle {saintName}: grant, we beseech Thee, that as we celebrate his heavenly birthday, we may also be protected by his prayers.
apostle.collectLatin: Deus, qui nos beati Apostoli tui {saintName} annua solemnitate lætificas: præsta, quæsumus; ut, cuius natalitia colimus, eius protegimur et orationibus.
apostle.collectEnglish: O God, who dost gladden us by the yearly festival of Thy blessed Apostle {saintName}: grant, we beseech Thee, that as we celebrate his heavenly birthday, we may also be protected by his prayers.
apostle.versicleLatin: ℣. In omnem terram exivit sonus eorum.
apostle.versicleEnglish: ℣. Their sound went forth into all the earth.
apostle.responseLatin: ℟. Et in fines orbis terræ verba eorum.
apostle.responseEnglish: ℟. And their words unto the ends of the world.

angels.intercessionLatin: Deus, qui miro ordine Angelorum ministeria hominumque dispensas: concede propitius; ut, a quibus tibi ministrantibus in cælo semper assistitur, ab his in terra vita nostra muniatur.
angels.intercessionEnglish: O God, who in a wonderful order hast ordained the services of Angels and men: mercifully grant, that as Thy holy Angels always do Thee service in heaven, so by Thy appointment they may succor, defend, and protect us on earth.
angels.collectLatin: Deus, qui miro ordine Angelorum ministeria hominumque dispensas: concede propitius; ut, a quibus tibi ministrantibus in cælo semper assistitur, ab his in terra vita nostra muniatur.
angels.collectEnglish: O God, who in a wonderful order hast ordained the services of Angels and men: mercifully grant, that as Thy holy Angels always do Thee service in heaven, so by Thy appointment they may succor, defend, and protect us on earth.
angels.versicleLatin: ℣. In conspectu Angelorum psallam tibi, Deus meus.
angels.versicleEnglish: ℣. I will sing praise unto Thee, my God, in the sight of the Angels.
angels.responseLatin: ℟. Adorabo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitebor nomini tuo.
angels.responseEnglish: ℟. I will worship toward Thy holy temple, and give glory unto Thy name.

martyr.intercessionLatin: Præsta, quæsumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, qui beati {saintName} Martyris tui natalitia colimus, a cunctis malis imminentibus, eius intercessione, liberemur.
martyr.intercessionEnglish: Grant, we beseech Thee, Almighty God: that we who celebrate the festival of blessed {saintName}, Thy Martyr, may by his intercession be delivered from all impending evils.
martyr.collectLatin: Præsta, quæsumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, qui beati {saintName} Martyris tui natalitia colimus, a cunctis malis imminentibus, eius intercessione, liberemur.
martyr.collectEnglish: Grant, we beseech Thee, Almighty God: that we who celebrate the festival of blessed {saintName}, Thy Martyr, may by his intercession be delivered from all impending evils.
martyr.versicleLatin: ℣. Gloria et honore coronasti eum, Domine.
martyr.versicleEnglish: ℣. Thou hast crowned him with glory and honor, O Lord.
martyr.responseLatin: ℟. Et constituisti eum super opera manuum tuarum.
martyr.responseEnglish: ℟. And hast set him over the works of Thy hands.

doctor.intercessionLatin: Deus, qui populo tuo æternæ salutis beatum {saintName} ministrum tribuisti: præsta, quæsumus; ut, quem Doctorem vitæ habuimus in terris, intercessorem habere mereamur in cælis.
doctor.intercessionEnglish: O God, who didst give blessed {saintName} to Thy people as a minister of eternal salvation: grant, we beseech Thee, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven, whom we have had as our teacher of life upon earth.
doctor.collectLatin: Deus, qui populo tuo æternæ salutis beatum {saintName} ministrum tribuisti: præsta, quæsumus; ut, quem Doctorem vitæ habuimus in terris, intercessorem habere mereamur in cælis.
doctor.collectEnglish: O God, who didst give blessed {saintName} to Thy people as a minister of eternal salvation: grant, we beseech Thee, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven, whom we have had as our teacher of life upon earth.
doctor.versicleLatin: ℣. Amavit eum Dominus, et ornavit eum.
doctor.versicleEnglish: ℣. The Lord loved him and adorned him.
doctor.responseEnglish: ℟. He clothed him with a robe of glory.

pope_bishop.intercessionLatin: Da, quæsumus, omnipotens Deus: ut beati {saintName} Confessoris tui atque Pontificis veneranda solemnitas, et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
pope_bishop.intercessionEnglish: Grant, we beseech Thee, Almighty God: that the venerable solemnity of blessed {saintName}, Thy Confessor and Bishop, may both increase our devotion and promote our salvation.
pope_bishop.collectLatin: Da, quæsumus, omnipotens Deus: ut beati {saintName} Confessoris tui atque Pontificis veneranda solemnitas, et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
pope_bishop.collectEnglish: Grant, we beseech Thee, Almighty God: that the venerable solemnity of blessed {saintName}, Thy Confessor and Bishop, may both increase our devotion and promote our salvation.
pope_bishop.versicleEnglish: ℣. Let Thy priests be clothed with justice.

virgin.intercessionLatin: Exaudi nos, Deus, salutaris noster: ut, sicut de beatæ {saintName} Virginis tuæ festivitate gaudemus; ita piæ devotionis erudiamur affectu.
virgin.intercessionEnglish: Hear us, O God of our salvation: that as we rejoice in the festival of blessed {saintName}, Thy Virgin; so we may be instructed in the affection of pious devotion.
virgin.collectLatin: Exaudi nos, Deus, salutaris noster: ut, sicut de beatæ {saintName} Virginis tuæ festivitate gaudemus; ita piæ devotionis erudiamur affectu.
virgin.collectEnglish: Exaudi nos, Deus, salutaris noster: ut, sicut de beatæ {saintName} Virginis tuæ festivitate gaudemus; ita piæ devotionis erudiamur affectu.
virgin.versicleEnglish: ℣. In thy comeliness and thy beauty.
virgin.responseEnglish: ℟. Go forth, proceed prosperously, and reign.

confessor_common.intercessionLatin: Deus, qui nos beati {saintName} Confessoris tui annua solemnitate lætificas: concede propitius; ut, cuius natalitia colimus, etiam actiones imitemur.
confessor_common.intercessionEnglish: O God, who dost gladden us by the yearly festival of blessed {saintName}, Thy Confessor: mercifully grant, that as we celebrate his heavenly birthday, we may also imitate his holy actions.
confessor_common.collectLatin: Deus, qui nos beati {saintName} Confessoris tui annua solemnitate lætificas: concede propitius; ut, cuius natalitia colimus, etiam actiones imitemur.
confessor_common.collectEnglish: O God, who dost gladden us by the yearly festival of blessed {saintName}, Thy Confessor: mercifully grant, that as we celebrate his heavenly birthday, we may also imitate his holy actions.
confessor_common.responseEnglish: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.
